title: Speech Generating Devices (SGD)
description: CMS National Coverage Determination for speech generating devices (NCD 50.1, HCPCS E2500-E2510). Covered for individuals with severe expressive speech impairments who have suffered significant anatomical or neurological impairment, following formal evaluation by a licensed Speech-Language Pathologist (SLP).

criteria.name: Severe Expressive Speech Impairment Precluding Daily Communication
criteria.description: Medical record documenting severe expressive communication impairment (aphasia, dysarthria, apraxia, laryngectomy) severely limiting daily communication.
criteria.source_text_excerpt: In addition, specific features of a speech generating device that are not used by the individual who has a severe speech impairment to meet his or her functional speaking needs are not covered.

criteria.name: Formal Evaluation by Licensed Speech-Language Pathologist (SLP)
criteria.description: Formal written assessment by a licensed Speech-Language Pathologist (SLP) recommending the specific device and detailing trial results with AAC systems.
criteria.source_text_excerpt: software that allows a computer or other electronic device to generate audible/verbal speech.

criteria.name: Non-Dedicated Personal Computer / Tablet Exclusion
criteria.description: Speech software requested on an unlocked commercial computer or smartphone that functions primarily as a general personal entertainment device.
criteria.clinical_intent: Statutory exclusion of non-dedicated non-medical computer hardware
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Computers and tablets are generally not considered DME because they are useful in the absence of an illness or injury.
